To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the pineapple variety N36 is highly recommended for fresh consumption and juice production due to its physico-chemical properties.
pineapple core and peel are the best maturity indices for pineapple variety N36 during storage.
pineapple peel, core, and crown extract are good source of sugar, which is an important component of the human diet.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the physicochemical properties changes of pineapple variety N 36 harvested and stored under ambient conditions at different maturity stages for seven days.
the physicochemical properties and colour changes of pineapple variety N37 during storage.
the development of a method for the determination of the physicochemical properties and the antioxidant activities of pineapple peel, pineapple core and pineapple crown extracts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
pineapple variety N36 can be harvested at maturity index 2 for storage and marketing.
the pineapple variety N36 is suitable for harvesting and storing at maturity index 2.
pineapple core extract has higher amount of total sugars compared to pineapple peel extract and crown extract.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the pineapple core extract was found as the richest source of total sugar content followed by peel and crown extracts.
pineapple core extract was the best maturity index of pineapple variety N-36 for storage and processing.

pineapple peel extract was significantly (p ≤0.05) higher in TSS and total sugar content compared with pineapple crown extract, while pineapple core extract had the highest TSS and total sugars content compared with pineapple peel and crown extract for all maturity stages.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the pineapple core extract has the highest total sugar content and the highest amount of fructose and glucose compared to pineapple peel extract and crown extract.
pineapple core extract is the most suitable extract for the maturity indices of pineapple variety N-36.
maturity index 2 is suitable for harvesting of pineapple variety N 36.
